rows.title: Nuwellis To Acquire Israel's Rendiatech
rows.description: (RTTNews) - Nuwellis, Inc. (NUWE), a medical technology company, on Tuesday announced that it has signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire Rendiatech, Ltd., an Israel-based medical device company. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2025.
